In October 2012, Superstorm Sandy left hundreds of thousands of homes in ruins, and some of the worst damage was sustained on the Jersey Shore; intrepid homeowners on the path to recovery learn lessons along the way.

title: This Old House
description:
S35 E02 — Jersey Shore: Drastic Measures
Beachfront homeowners are determined to pool their own resources to build a stone and sand revetment; at the Point Pleasant project, the homeowner is mired in scheduling setbacks; a structural engineer explains a FEMA A zone versus a V zone.

title: This Old House
description:
S35 E03 — Jersey Shore: Getting to Work
A builder shows Norm the progress on the framing; the Point Pleasant house is up on cribbing; traditional wooden piles are a cost-effective way to go for new construction; Norm takes Richard to see a Mueller's Bakery.

title: This Old House
description:
S35 E04 — Jersey Shore: Built for Speed
Kevin meets Mayor Akers and Lou Cirigliano from Casino Pier to check out the work in progress at Seaside Heights, N.J.; Norm finds the framing complete at the Bay Head cottage and the crew installing decking on the porch.

title: This Old House
description:
S35 E05 — Jersey Shore: Lines in the Sand
Sand shoaling now obstructs the waterways; fitting a hurricane-resistant window package and structural hardware at junctures; a plumber is repairing damage, running new gas and sewer lines; the arrival of the modules that will form Rita's new house.

title: This Old House
description:
S35 E06 — Jersey Shore: Go With the Flow
A natural barrier island; in Point Pleasant, Carlos removes siding, fits hurricane strapping, and pours a slab; insulated CMU "breakaway wall" panels; bringing back Jersey Shore landscapes after Sandy; the progress on Rita's modular Cape.

title: This Old House
description:
S35 E07 — Jersey Shore: Stories From Sea Level
Getting a lesson in surfing; the Bay Head house is lifted to its final height; complications of trying to pour footings at sea level; why fiber cement siding makes sense; installing composite decking; the punch list is completed.

title: This Old House
description:
S35 E08 — Jersey Shore: One Year Later
A year after Sandy, Norm and Kevin take stock of recovery at the Jersey Shore; Richard visits Mantoloking to see a house that survived a breach; Kevin checks out the Point Pleasant project; Richard finds a landscaper planting some container gardens.

title: This Old House
description:
S35 E09 — Arlington Italianate: A New Project
A modest 1872 Italianate-style remodel in Arlington, Mass.; the homeowners want to open up the floor plan and make a bigger kitchen; they plan to create a master suite; the challenges of foundation work; a host of issues in finishing the basement.

title: This Old House
description:
S35 E10 — Arlington Italianate: Old House Discoveries
Richard investigates an Arlington Heights landmark; back at the house, Tom shows Kevin a hidden back staircase, ceiling height, and decent framing; second-floor joists in the former full bath are badly compromised, and the old stairs need removal.

title: This Old House
description:
S35 E11 — Arlington Italianate: Concrete Jungle
Tom doing more demo; Mark McCullough is ready to get the new foundation going and Kevin lends a hand; the pitched floor and ledge are dug and cut out to make room for a level floor; a concrete curb; Tom and Kevin make a breathtaking discovery.

title: This Old House
description:
S35 E12 — Arlington Italianate: Quest for a Dry Basement
Tom frames the new roof; to repair and repoint the failing brick foundation, something is added to keep water at bay. Roger meets a landscape architect to see an Italianate Garden; Norm helps Tom cut through the wall for the new mudroom entrance.

title: This Old House
description:
S35 E13 — Arlington Italianate: Getting to Level
The new floor plan; explaining the system to ensure a flat ceiling in the kitchen; leveling out the existing concrete floor; options for the front yard; reviewing shade gardens, woodland paths and hardscape options; window openings.

title: Ask This Old House
description:
S15 E11 — Walkway; Mead; Wiring
Roger rips up an old, dangerous walkway to replace it with bluestone; Scott explains the best wire nuts to use for each project; Kevin gets a lesson on making mead.

title: Ask This Old House
description:
S15 E12 — Heating; Hand Saw; LED
An environmentally safe way to keep walkways safe during the winter; showing how and when to use hand saws; helping a homeowner diagnose a problem with a hot water radiator; installing thin LED lights underneath the overhang of a homeowner's garage.

title: Ask This Old House
description:
S15 E13 — Garden; Shed; Stains
Landscape designer Jenn Nawada learns about rooftop and small space gardens; Tom explains the best practices to remove stains from plaster and drywall; Scott helps a homeowner power his shed by running electricity underground from his house.

title: Ask This Old House
description:
S15 E14 — Future House; Offerman
Kevin gets a firsthand look at Nick Offerman's woodworking shop; home technology expert Ross Trethewey looks at a new device to track home energy usage in Future House; Richard shows what happens when one uses the wrong soap in the dishwasher.

title: Ask This Old House
description:
S15 E15 — NASA; Simulated Panels
Tom is in Cincinnati to create a simulated wainscoting out of base cap molding; NASA astronaut Mike Foreman shows off a few space tools; Richard helps a homeowner get enough hot water for his children's bath time.

title: Ask This Old House
description:
S15 E16 — Built It; Downlights
Tom and Kevin use scrap wood to create an end grain cutting board in Build It; Scott installs surface-mounted downlights in a living room; What Is It?; Roger discusses the best ways to keep mice out of the house.

title: Ask This Old House
description:
S15 E17 — Light Lift; Kentucky Lawn Care
Scott helps a homeowner raise and lower a light with a motorized lift; Tom shows Kevin the best uses for a jigsaw and how to choose blades; Roger visits Kentucky to help a homeowner repair his once lush lawn.

title: Ask This Old House
description:
S15 E18 — Passage Set; Landscape
Tom helps a homeowner install a new door knob passage set on his closet door; Richard gives a history lesson about plumbing and shows off new toilet technology; Jenn uses a historic landscape design as inspiration to revive an overgrown backyard.

title: Ask This Old House
description:
S15 E19 — Hot Water; Storm Door
Richard revisits a homeowner to repair a water heater he thought was fixed four years ago; Tom installs a storm door with a dog in mind; Ross Trethewey looks at voice-activated smart devices.

title: Ask This Old House
description:
S15 E20 — Buildt It; Cable Lights
The dangers of carbon monoxide and how an operational CO detector could be the difference between life and death; using stock lumber and millwork from a home center to build a home message center that mimics a window; a white orb on a stake.

title: Ask This Old House
description:
S15 E21 — Water Filter; Fire Pit
Richard installs a whole house water filtration system; Tom walks Kevin through various types of woods; Ross visits a hotel room that's powered by voice activation; Jenn Nawada installs a bluestone patio with a reclaimed granite fire pit.

title: Ask This Old House
description:
S15 E22 — Generator; Wood Floor
Scott visits Alaska to install a portable generator with a manual transfer switch to power hardwired appliances; Richard goes inside a dishwasher to explain each cycle; Tom repairs a piece of wood nosing.

title: Ask This Old House
description:
S15 E23 — Primer; Pipes; Heat
Painter Mauro Henrique demonstrates a masking primer that leaves clean lines on a window; Richard tracks down the source of a clogged drain using some high-tech equipment; Scott warms up a chilly bathroom by installing an electric convection heater.

title: This Old House
description:
S44 E02 — Atlanta Postmaster's House: Unsafe Structures
Unsafe structures are uncovered and demolished; building a lending library; saving an oak tree.

title: This Old House
description:
S44 E03 — Atlanta Postmaster's House: School of HVAC
Touring the Atlanta BeltLine; replacing the existing footings with a stem wall; adding a vapor barrier to a crawl space; a lesson on HVAC installation; touring an outdoor learning center.

title: This Old House
description:
S44 E04 — Atlanta Postmaster's House: Cardboard Kitchen
Putting up new framing; installing ductwork; exploring native fruit trees; cardboard boxes make for a real kitchen feel; restoring old windows.

title: This Old House
description:
S44 E05 — Atlanta Postmaster's House: Whole House Protection
Progress is made on the interior and exterior of the house; bevel pine siding is woven into the old; touring Tyler Perry Studios; adding lightning and surge protection; the Dracut Centre School restoration is completed.

title: Ask This Old House
description:
S10 E25 — Generator; Clogged Sewer
Host Kevin O'Connor and electrician Scott Caron travel to Annapolis, Md., to install a manual transfer switch for a portable generator; the guys ask What Is It?; Richard heads to Dallas to fix a sewer line that is clogged with tree roots.

title: Ask This Old House
description:
S10 E26 — Spray Paint; Wood Floor
Roger Cook and Kevin refinish several worn-out items using spray paint; Richard Trethewey shows Kevin some new household devices that can be operated hands-free; Tom Silva removes wall-to-wall carpet and installs a pre-finished wood floor.

title: Ask This Old House
description:
S11 E01 — Shelves; Washing Machine
General contractor Tom Silva helps a couple transform stock shelving into a custom built-in; plumbing and heating expert Richard Trethewey installs a new washing machine valve that will prevent flooding.

title: Ask This Old House
description:
S11 E02 — Bluestone Patio; Bikes
Landscape contractor Roger Cook helps a homeowner install a bluestone patio in an urban backyard; What Is It?; Tom helps a homeowner and her daughter hang their bikes in a small garage; in the loft, Roger demonstrates the single-folding bike rack.

description:
S17 E15 — Stucco Repair; Gas Dryer
Mark travels to San Diego to repair a crack in a concrete retaining wall with a stucco finish; Tom explains how air compressors work; Richard helps an expecting couple select and install a gas dryer.

title: Ask This Old House
description:
S17 E16 — Paint Metal Railing; Wine Rack
Mauro helps clean up and repaint a rusty, metal railing; Richard discusses some innovations that can make clearing a clogged sink easier; Tom and Kevin build a wine rack out of a reclaimed beam.

title: Ask This Old House
description:
S17 E17 — Prairie Grasses; Solar Flower
Jenn learns about different types of prairie grasses and how to care for them; Kevin learns how to make a home more resistant to wildfires; Ross sees a robotic, ground mounted solar array.

title: Ask This Old House
description:
S17 E18 — Smart Irrigation; Jimmy DiResta
Jenn upgrades an irrigation system; the team looks at Home Inspection Nightmares; Tom discusses kitchen renovations; Kevin builds an Adirondack-style outdoor chair with Jimmy DiResta.

title: Ask This Old House
description:
S17 E19 — Water Filter; Bathroom Caulking
Richard updates a filter on a retro faucet; Mark explains different masonry jointers; Nathan explains when and how to use a Japanese pull saw; Tom demonstrates how to re-caulk a bathtub.

title: Ask This Old House
description:
S17 E20 — Fix Foundation; Textured Ceiling
Mark repoints a crumbling fieldstone foundation; Tom discusses proper disposal techniques for oily rags; Mauro smooths over a textured ceiling using joint compound.

title: Ask This Old House
description:
S17 E21 — Stair Treads; Gas Stove Pipe
Tom replaces split-level stair treads in a mid-century modern home; Jenn shares some tips about pruners; Richard shortens a gas pipe for a stove that doesn't fit against the wall.

title: Ask This Old House
description:
S17 E22 — Restore Fireplace; Porch Swing
Roger and Jenn share tips for killing weeds; Mark restores a damaged historic fireplace; Richard and Ross discuss thermostat improvements; Tom adds structure to a porch to safely hang a swing.

title: Ask This Old House
description:
S17 E23 — Scorched Floor; Hardy Plantings
Ross tests out a new stud finder; Nathan repairs a wood floor burned by a hot iron; Tom gives techniques for using a table saw safely; Jenn replaces crushed foundation plantings.

title: Ask This Old House
description:
S17 E24 — Humidity Mystery, Brick Patch
Conversations a homeowner and contractor should have before a project; Richard repairs an HVAC system that is creating too much humidity; Mauro demonstrates a paint sprayer; Mark patches a brick wall.

title: This Old House
description:
S35 E14 — Arlington Italianate: Details on the Addition
Windows installed in the new eat-in kitchen; Tom ties in the second-floor addition with matching clapboards; Tom shows Kevin how he's replicating the 150-year-old corbels; back in the basement, Richard removes the waste pipe in the way of the stairs.

title: This Old House
description:
S35 E15 — Arlington Italianate: Arlington Heights
Roger is onsite with a solid plan to let light into the yard; Richard revisits the benefits of using PEX instead of copper for the water supply lines; Tom shows Kevin how to convert a jamb that once held a door into an elegant cased opening.

title: This Old House
description:
S35 E16 — Arlington Italianate: Italianate Inspiration
Historically informed options for painting the exterior of the Italianate-style home; patching holes in the veneer floors; a solution to the ugly PVC intake; finishing up the roughs; places upstairs that should get radiant heat.

title: This Old House
description:
S35 E17 — Arlington Italianate: Deadliest Old House?
Tom Silva puts special guest Edgar Hansen to work patching cracks in the horsehair plaster; Norm and Tom raise the height of the railing on the second-floor landing; removing the old set of concrete stairs at the front entry.

title: This Old House
description:
S35 E18 — Arlington Italianate: Old World, New World
Roger uses granite steps for the front entry; Roger places the middle step on a bed of ice; the moldings and medallion are repaired; a 3D printing specialist shows how the repairs can be made by a computer; a railing is added to the porch.

title: This Old House
description:
S35 E19 — Arlington Italianate: Hydrangeas and Hail Storms
How to remove a hydrangea with roots undermining the foundation of the house; the final exterior paint color; Kevin travels to Richburg, S.C., to see how building materials hold up to hail; keeping water and dampness at bay in the basement.

title: This Old House
description:
S35 E20 — Arlington Italianate: Water, Water Everywhere
A look at Arlington's Spy Pond and the ice-harvesting industry; water pressure problems; Tom installs the new pre-finished Brazilian chestnut flooring in the kitchen; Norm and installer Peter Robinson install the new gutters at the house.
